subject: Participation in customer follow-up is voluntary, and customer history reconstruction and proposed random assignment are limited to consenting participants.
rationale: The proposition defines a coherent prospective participation gate: invite voluntary participation and permit customer history reconstruction or proposed random assignment only for consenting participants. Absence of consent excludes participation in those activities. The unspecified consent procedure does not undermine the determinacy of this rule at the stated scope. This judgment concerns the proposed decision structure, not whether consent has actually been obtained or respected.
